حماية الصمام

Definition

A safety device or enclosure designed to shield the valve of a gas cylinder from impact or accidental operation during handling and transport.

Operational example

Valve protection must be fitted on cylinders during transport to prevent damage or accidental discharge as per IMDG and ADR regulations.

Localized term
